## Evidence rule

Documentation review, sample payloads, synthetic fixtures, local unit tests and unlicensed data do not constitute a PQA result. A future result must bind the candidate, product, upstream source, account, entitlement, terms, test version, time window, raw evidence digest, expected result, observed result, defect disposition and accountable acceptance.
